Data Workbench Studio / JSON Diff

Local JSON Diff Tool

Data Workbench JSON Diff compares two JSON payloads locally at the path, value, and array level, supporting ignorePaths, ignoreArrayOrder, numericTolerance, and XSS-safe HTML or Markdown reports.

Spotting a Silent API Change Hidden Behind Volatile Timestamps

Text-based line diffs fall apart on JSON: if a backend reorders an array or updates a fetched_at timestamp on every call, git diff lights up red across hundreds of lines while hiding the one field whose type quietly flipped from number to string. Path-level JSON Diff with ignorePaths and numeric tolerance isolates genuine behavioral changes in seconds.

Run the Same Step in Terminal or CI

dw diff ./v1.json ./v2.json --format html --output ./json-diff.html

Frequently Asked Questions

Can JSON Diff ignore volatile fields like timestamps or request IDs?

Yes. Pass JSON paths such as $.fetched_at into ignorePaths to focus strictly on meaningful payload changes.

How are type changes reported?

Type mismatches (such as integer changing to string) are classified separately as typeChanged so breaking API regressions stand out immediately.
